Inglewood, California
  February 25, 2020

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, February 25, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.
The Acting City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Cheryl Moore  Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor
Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
Council on Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed Session
Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called
the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing
Authority, Finance Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at
the hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Finance
Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority
Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority  Chairman/Finance  Authority

  Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority  Members/Finance  Authority
  Members/Parking  Authority  Members/Joint
  Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority / Finance Authority / Parking
Authority /Joint Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member

  Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  COMMISSION’S DENIAL OF SPECIAL USE PERMIT NO. 2019-014 (SP-
  2019-014) TO ALLOW THE SALE OF BEER AND WINE FOR OFF-SITE
  CONSUMPTION FROM AN EXISTING CONVENIENCE MARKET AT
  400 WEST MANCHESTER BOULEVARD.

  This item was pulled from the Agenda.

  RESOLUTION NO. 19-08 FOR SPECIAL USE PERMIT NO. 2018-007;
  RESOLUTION NO. 20-40 ADOPTED – UPHOLDING PLANNING
  COMMISSION’S RESOLUTION NO. 18-15. The City Clerk announced that
  the next scheduled matter was a public hearing to consider a modified Resolution
  to replace Resolution No. 19-08 for Special Use Permit No. 2018-007, which
  allowed a 12-bed community care residential health facility at 814 North Market
  Street, that notice had been given in the time, form, and manner as required by
  law, and no communications were received.

  Artie Fields, City Manager, presented the Staff Report dated February 25, 2020.

  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager, gave a brief oral report.

  Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address the
  City Council on this matter.

  No name given stated that he doesn’t want the facility used as a halfway house.

  Christy McClorkal stated squatters are hanging around the building and no
  information is given out about what the plans are for this building.

  Mayor Butts ordered the public comment portion closed at the hour of 2:18 p.m.

  Following discussions, it was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded
  by Council Member Morales that the City Council does hereby adopt Resolution
  No. 20-40 entitled:

  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;

  Noes: None.
